sections.title: Quick Take — Which LIC Term Insurance Plan Is Best for You?

content.text: For most buyers who want low cost + high trust, LIC New Tech-Term (Plan No. 954) is the best overall choice because of its competitive online-only premium. If you prefer in-person guidance for a high-value policy, consider the offline counterpart LIC New Jeevan Amar (Plan No. 955). For very small/simple needs, Saral Jeevan Bima is a good starter. For comprehensive financial planning, use our retirement corpus calculator to determine the right coverage amount. I generally advise against Return-of-Premium (ROP) plans like Jeevan Kiran unless you prefer guaranteed return of paid premiums and accept significantly higher cost.

Get a free LIC term quote in 2 minutes — enter age & desired cover. No obligation.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios. This LIC term insurance calculator helps you get an exact quote for your profile—premiums for a LIC term insurance 1 crore policy differ widely by age and product.

sections.title: LIC Term Insurance Plans — Comparison Guide

content.footer: Subject to LIC's underwriting and maximum coverage limits based on income.

items.title: 1. LIC New Tech-Term — Plan No. 954
items.text:
Type: Online-only, pure term (non-participating)
Key benefit: Lowest LIC premiums thanks to online rebate.
Best for: Self-directed, tech-savvy buyers who want cheapest pure protection from LIC.

items.title: 2. LIC New Jeevan Amar — Plan No. 955
items.text:
Type: Offline equivalent of Tech-Term, sold via agents.
Key benefit: Agent support and servicing convenience.
Best for: Buyers who value face-to-face help for application & servicing.

items.title: 3. Saral Jeevan Bima — Plan No. 859
items.text:
Type: Standardized pure-term product mandated by IRDAI for simplicity.
Key benefit: Simple features, accessible; usually covers up to ₹25 Lakh.
Best for: First-time buyers and low-cover needs.

items.title: 4. LIC Jeevan Kiran — Plan No. 870 — ROP
items.text:
Type: Return-of-Premium term plan.
Key benefit: All base premiums returned on survival (excl. taxes, rider premiums).
Best for: Highly risk-averse buyers who want a savings-like result — but be aware of the high cost.

sections.title: Key Features & Benefits of LIC Term Insurance

items: High Sum Assured: LIC term plans offer substantial coverage amounts, often going up to ₹1 crore and beyond, ensuring your family's financial needs are fully met.
Affordable Premiums: For a non-smoker, a high-value lic term insurance 1 crore policy can be secured for a very competitive monthly premium, especially when purchased online.
Flexible Payout Options: Nominees can choose to receive the death benefit as a lump sum, as a regular income, or a combination of both, providing flexibility to manage finances.
Rider Availability: You can enhance your protection by adding riders for accidental death, disability, or critical illness.

Tax Benefits: Premiums paid are eligible for tax deductions under Section 80C, and the death benefit payout to the nominee is tax-free under Section 10(10D). Compare your options with our tax regime calculator and explore savings alternatives like our FD vs PPF calculator and PPF calculator for comparing investment returns.

Multiple Premium Payment Terms: Choose from Single, Regular, or Limited premium payment terms to align with your financial capacity. Compare these with our LIC premium calculator for all available plans.

sections.title: How LIC Term Premiums Are Calculated (Short & Practical)

content.text: Premiums are actuarial — they reflect the insurer’s assessment of risk. Main factors:

items: Age at entry — biggest driver (younger = cheaper).
Smoker / tobacco use — smokers pay materially higher premiums.
Sum assured — higher cover increases premium linearly.
Policy term & PPT — longer terms and different paying terms affect cost.
Gender & health — underwriting can adjust prices based on gender and health disclosures.
Riders — each rider adds a premium.

content.text: Small changes (1–2 years of age, smoker → non-smoker) can change monthly premium noticeably — always pull an instant quote using our main LIC premium calculator.

Recent online plans (Tech-Term, Digi Term) now offer competitive pricing for self-service buyers. sections.title: Riders & Add-ons — What to Consider (and What to Avoid)

items.title: Worth considering
items.text:
• Accidental Death & Disability (AD&DB): inexpensive and high incremental protection.
  • Critical Illness (CI): useful if you don’t have robust health cover.

items.title: Use caution
items.text:
• Return-of-Premium (ROP): high cost; financially often inferior to buying pure term + investing the difference.
  • Excessive layering of riders: can push your monthly outlay much higher; buy only what materially improves your family’s protection.

items.title: Intimation
items.text: Nominee files claim at servicing branch with death certificate, original policy & KYC.

items.title: Verification
items.text: LIC verifies documents; may request hospital records or post-mortem if required.

items.title: IRDAI timelines
items.text: Non-investigated claims to be settled within 30 days of receiving all documents; investigations can extend timelines (up to ~120 days for complex cases).

items.title: Tip
items.text: Keep digital copies & a claim folder for your nominee to speed the process.

items.q: What is the LIC Tech-Term Plan and how is it different?
items.a: LIC Tech-Term is an online-only pure term plan sold directly by LIC on their e-services portal. Because there are no agent commissions involved, it offers significantly lower premiums compared to LIC's offline equivalents. It is designed for self-directed buyers who want a cheap, robust pure protection plan.

items.q: Can I buy LIC term insurance online?
items.a: Yes, you can absolutely buy LIC term insurance online. LIC offers the New Tech-Term and Digi Term plans exclusively through their online portal. The online process requires you to fill out the application, submit KYC documents like your PAN and Aadhaar, and optionally complete a tele-medical or physical medical exam.

items.q: How much premium for ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance for a 30-year-old non-smoker?
items.a: For a 30-year-old healthy non-smoker male, the premium for a ₹1 Crore LIC Tech-Term policy for a 30-year term typically ranges between ₹10,000 to ₹13,000 annually (roughly ₹900 to ₹1,100 monthly) before GST. Premiums vary slightly based on the exact term and your medical history, so using our premium calculator is highly recommended.

items.q: Which is better: LIC Tech-Term or LIC Jeevan Amar?
items.a: Both plans offer the exact same coverage and features. The only difference is the purchasing channel. LIC Tech-Term is an online-only plan with lower premiums since there are no intermediary commissions. LIC Jeevan Amar is an offline plan bought through an agent, which means higher premiums but you receive personalized, face-to-face assistance for application and future claim servicing. Choose based on your comfort level.

Return-of-Premium (ROP) plans, like LIC Jeevan Kiran, return your base premiums if you survive the policy term. While this sounds appealing, the premiums for ROP plans are often double or triple the cost of pure term plans. Financially, buying a cheap pure term plan and investing the difference (e.g., in a PPF or mutual fund) usually yields a much higher overall return.

items.q: Does LIC settle term claims reliably?
items.a: Yes, LIC is highly reliable and boasts one of the highest Claim Settlement Ratios (CSR) in the industry, consistently staying above 98.5%. Because it is backed by the government of India, it carries an immense trust factor. However, it's always critical to declare your medical history accurately to ensure smooth claim processing.

items.q: LIC term insurance vs HDFC Life Click2Protect: Which is better?
items.a: LIC offers unmatched sovereign trust and an excellent rural and urban service network, but its premiums can be slightly higher than private insurers. Private plans like HDFC Life Click2Protect often provide lower premiums, more innovative riders (like income-replacement or wellness discounts), and a smoother digital experience. Both are highly reliable; your choice depends on whether you value government backing or aggressive pricing and features.

items.q: What is the Saral Jeevan Bima plan?
items.a: Saral Jeevan Bima is a standardized, simple pure-term insurance product mandated by the IRDAI across all insurers. Its features are identical regardless of which company you buy it from. It typically provides coverage up to ₹25 Lakhs, making it an excellent entry-level policy for first-time buyers or those with lower coverage requirements.

items.q: How to claim LIC term insurance after death?
items.a: To claim LIC term insurance, the nominee must visit the home branch where the policy is serviced. They need to submit the death claim form, the original policy document, the municipal death certificate, and their KYC documents. If the claim is straightforward and non-investigated, LIC typically settles it within 15 to 30 days of receiving all the completed documents.

items.q: Can I change the nominee in my LIC term policy online?
items.a: While LIC has significantly upgraded its e-services portal to handle premium payments, address updates, and loans, changing a nominee often still requires submitting a physical 'Change of Nomination' form at your servicing branch for verification. Always confirm the current digital capabilities on the LIC portal for your specific policy type.

content.text: LIC term insurance offers an unparalleled combination of trust and security. For most users, the LIC Tech-Term plan offers the best balance of low cost and high trust. To create a comprehensive financial safety net, consider combining term insurance with other savings and investment vehicles.
